hints.title: Cyclic Index Shift
hints.text: Each character at index i is replaced by the character located at index (i + k) % n.

hints.title: String Slicing
hints.text: Equivalently, the encrypted string is the original string rotated left by k % n positions.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; linear pass is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) memory for the rotated string.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Express string rotation via modulo arithmetic cleanly.
